completeness.why: All five bulk actions now take their category selection from isWrittenByMonthAction (hidden/group-hidden/income rule moved out of per-site SQL and conditions), with the action kind ('copy'|'zero'|'average') selecting the preserved variations (setZero writes hidden, missing group copied vs skipped); both sign inversions go through toAverageBudgetAmount. The await differences remain at the sites, which is site-level handling.

interface.why: A single function with an explicit action parameter names the real variations (zero writes hidden, copy keeps groupless categories, average requires a visible group) and a separate sign helper; the null-group difference is encoded only via !== 1 vs === 0, explained by a comment, and CategoryFlags restates the existing BudgetData flag fields.

disguised_duplication.where: Rule logic is centralised; only minor overlap remains: the new CategoryFlags type repeats BudgetData's flag fields and getCategoriesWithGroupHidden repeats the category/group LEFT JOIN of getBudgetData, both open rather than disguised.
